provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: exact: no pair of the 36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states spans |CS>^2, decided in Q(i) by canonicalising each state's component off the target

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 15 s for the certificate

notes: Settles chi(|CS>^2) = 3 with the verified three-term witness, against the product bound 4. Exact throughout: the 36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states are enumerated from the verifier's parametrisation as vectors over Z[i] (reduced-row-echelon flats, strictly upper-triangular Q, l in Z_4^k; count checked against 2^4 (2+1)(4+1)(8+1)(16+1), pairwise distinct up to phase, and matched one to one against the numerical dictionary as a consistency check nothing rests on). With P = 4|CS>^2 the component q(s) = <P,P> s - <P,s> P of each state off the target stays in Z[i], and P lies in span(s, t) exactly when q(s) and q(t) are parallel, which is decided by dividing each q(s) by its first nonzero entry in Q(i) and comparing: no two coincide and none vanishes. The design note's numerical search (2026-09-20) found the same with closest approach to parallel 0.763 against the threshold 1 - 1e-6; this certificate removes the margin. Controls: |++++> is reported as rank 1, |CS> (x) |++> is spanned by pairs, and on two qubits the pair {|++>, CZ|++>} is found for |CS>. The script also prints chi(CS^3) >= 3 by projection monotonicity, (I (x) <00|)|CS>^3 = |CS>^2 / 2.
